entries.title: III John 1:1
segments: The Elder to the beloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth.

entries.title: III John 1:2
segments: I pray that you may prosper, beloved, in every way, and be in good health, even as your soul is prospering.

entries.title: III John 1:3
segments: For I was glad when brothers came and bore testimony to your truth, as indeed you are passing your life in truth.

entries.title: III John 1:4
segments: I have no greater joy than this, to hear that my children are passing their lives in the truth.

entries.title: III John 1:5
segments: You are acting faithfully, beloved, in whatever you are doing for the brothers and the strangers.

entries.title: III John 1:6
segments: They have borne testimony to your love before the church. You will do well to speed them on their way worthily of God;

entries.title: III John 1:7
segments: since for the sake of the Name they have started out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.

entries.title: III John 1:8
segments: Hence we ought to support such, so that we may become fellow workers for the truth.

entries.title: III John 1:9
segments: I have written somewhat to the church; but Diotrephes, who love to take the lead among them, does not receive me.

entries.title: III John 1:10
segments: Do them when I come I will recall to mind the deeds which he is doing, prating against me with wicked words. Not satisfied with that, he refuses to receive the brothers, forbids those that would receive them, and excommunicates them from the church.

entries.title: III John 1:11
segments: Do not imitate what is evil, beloved, but that which is good. He who does good is of God; he who does evil has never gazed on God.

entries.title: III John 1:12
segments: All men bear testimony to Demetrius, and so does the truth itself. I also bear testimony to him; and you know that my testimony is true.

entries.title: III John 1:13
segments: I have a great deal to write to you, but I do not want to write you with pen and ink.

entries.title: III John 1:14
segments: I am hoping soon to see you, and then we shall talk face to face. Peace be to you! The friends send their salutation. Salute the friends by name.
